Is This You?

If any of this sounds familiar, you're in the right place.

"I hit a wall every afternoon — no matter how much coffee I drink." ▼

The crash isn't a caffeine problem. It's a cellular energy problem. Your cells produce less NAD+ with age — which means less sustained fuel, more crashes. NMN is what your body uses to support that fuel production.

"I've tried supplements before. Nothing worked." ▼

There's a reason. Independent testing shows NMN quality varies dramatically between brands. If you tried NMN and felt nothing, the issue may not have been NMN — it may have been what was actually in the bottle.

"I feel like I've aged 10 years in the last 2." ▼

That feeling has a name: NAD+ decline. It's measurable, it's published science, and it's addressable. Not with hype. With the molecule your cells have been running low on.

"I just want enough energy to actually show up for my family." ▼

The exhaustion isn't a willpower problem. After 40, your cells produce significantly less of the molecule responsible for sustained energy. NMN supports your body's ability to produce more of it — so you have something left at 6pm.

"Every 'anti-aging' product is about wrinkles. I just want to function." ▼

The decline you're feeling isn't cosmetic — it's cellular. Alongside hormonal changes, NAD+ levels drop significantly in your 40s and 50s. NMN supports the energy side of the equation from the inside. Not cream. Fuel.

How It Works

Simple enough to explain in 30 seconds. Backed by enough research to fill a library.

01

Take 2 Capsules Daily

Two capsules every morning. 500mg of NMN plus 8 synergistic ingredients — all in one serving. No stacking. No timing. No cabinet full of bottles.

02

Your Body Does What It Already Knows How to Do

NMN converts directly to NAD+ — the molecule your cells already use to produce energy and repair themselves. The other 9 ingredients support the same pathways. Nothing foreign. Just more of what your body already runs on.

03

You Start Feeling Like You Again

You get to 4pm and you're still there — still present, still sharp, still you. Not a spike and crash. A higher baseline. The kind of change someone else notices first.

That's it. Ten ingredients. One serving. Two capsules. Everything your cells need to support the energy, defense, and maintenance systems that decline with age.

What's Actually Inside — And Why

Every ingredient was chosen for a specific role in cellular health. No filler. No random additions.

NMN (β-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide)

500mg — Full Clinical Dose

The foundation of the formula. NMN converts directly to NAD+ — the molecule behind energy production, DNA maintenance, and sirtuin activation. 500mg is the dose used in published human research. Not a token amount.

Vitamin C (as Ascorbyl Palmitate)

50mg — Fat-Soluble Form

A fat-soluble form of vitamin C that supports antioxidant defense and protects cells from oxidative damage. Works alongside the other antioxidants in the formula.

The Synergy Blend

450mg combined — 8 ingredients that support how NAD+ works in your cells

Resveratrol

The Sirtuin Activator

▼

Standardized to 98% trans-resveratrol — the bioactive form. NMN provides the NAD+ fuel; resveratrol tells your cells what to do with it. The most-studied NMN pairing in longevity research.

CoQ10

The Mitochondrial Fuel

▼

Essential for energy production inside your mitochondria. Your body produces less CoQ10 as you age — just like NAD+. Supports cellular energy alongside NMN.

Glutathione

The Master Antioxidant

▼

Reduced (active) form. Neutralizes free radicals and supports detoxification at the cellular level. NAD+ production and antioxidant defense work hand-in-hand.

TMG / Trimethylglycine

The Methyl Donor

▼

NMN metabolism uses methyl groups. TMG replenishes them — supporting healthy methylation for DNA regulation and cellular signaling. This is why serious NMN users pair NMN with TMG.

Grape Seed Extract

The Cardiovascular Protector

▼

A potent source of proanthocyanidins — powerful antioxidants that support cardiovascular health and protect cells from oxidative stress.

Quercetin

The Cellular Cleanup

▼

A flavonoid that supports your body's ability to clear damaged, aging cells. Also supports a healthy inflammatory response — increasingly important with age.

Astaxanthin

The Deep-Cell Antioxidant

▼

From Haematococcus pluvialis microalgae — one of the most powerful natural antioxidants known. Crosses the blood-brain barrier, supporting both brain and body.

Apigenin

The NAD+ Protector

▼

Inhibits CD38 — an enzyme that breaks down NAD+ as you age. NMN helps produce more NAD+. Apigenin helps you keep more of it. A two-sided approach.

Why These 10 Together

Most people who research longevity end up taking 5-8 separate products — $150-$300/month from different brands. This formula combines them into one serving. One bottle instead of five.
